Whether [[Widget loops|widget loops]] are rigid is contested: crystal structures show uniformly low mobility, while studies of [[Loop dynamics|loop dynamics]] in solution see constant switching. The two observations may reflect different environments rather than a true conflict.

## Evidence

### [[alpha2020|Alpha (2020): B-factors in crystal structures]]

Loop backbones in the survey had uniformly low B-factors, which the authors read as rigidity.

### [[gamma2021|Gamma (2021): simulations of loops in solution]]

No simulated loop stayed in one shape, which contradicts rigidity in solution.
